units.source_text: 一般人认为，外行人读物理学感觉到香、音、色，这只是他们的感觉器官不同，实际上人的本性是一样的。

en.t: Ordinary people believe that when lay readers sense fragrance, sound, and color while reading physics, it is only because their sense organs differ; in reality, human nature is the same.

units.source_text: 据说，科学家们也把灵魂的力量当作与电或磁力相同的东西，编出活灵活现的童话故事来。

en.t: It is said that scientists, too, treat the power of the soul as something like electricity or magnetism, and spin vivid fairy tales from it.
